offline-net.sh.content_utf8:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
python3 -I -c 'import socket,fcntl,struct; s=socket.socket(socket.AF_INET,socket.SOCK_DGRAM); q=struct.pack("16sH22x",b"lo",0); v=fcntl.ioctl(s.fileno(),0x8913,q); fcntl.ioctl(s.fileno(),0x8914,struct.pack("16sH22x",b"lo",struct.unpack_from("H",v,16)[0]|1))'
exec "$@"
